provider: BLS Public Data API (Bureau of Labor Statistics)
category: government economic data API (CPI, employment, wages, productivity time series)

free_tier.stated: Version 1.0, no registration: 25 queries a day, 25 series a query, 10 years a query, 50 requests per 10 seconds; Version 2.0 with a free registration key: 500 queries a day, 50 series, 20 years
free_tier.notes: Version 2.0 also returns net and percent changes, annual averages and series descriptions, and the key must be renewed at least once a year. A keyless v1 time-series call answered HTTP 200. The www.bls.gov pages answered HTTP 403 to an automated page fetch with no declared agent.

egress.terms: not metered in bytes; the daily query count bounds a caller

interface_detail: GET or POST https://api.bls.gov/publicAPI/v1/timeseries/data/SERIESID with no key; v2 adds the registrationkey with the same signatures
tooling: curl or any HTTP client; sample code is published for several languages
chaining: US labour and price series for free; they pair with FRED and Fiscal Data when a model mixes macro sources.

limits.value: 50 requests per 10 seconds on both versions
25 series and 10 years per query unregistered; 50 series and 20 years registered

limits_note: Bulk path: flat files under download.bls.gov/pub/time.series/, one directory per survey, with no key.
binding_note: 25 queries a day unregistered, 500 registered, is met long before the 50 per 10 seconds rate.

identity_cost.detail: Version 1.0 needs nothing. A Version 2.0 key needs an email address and an organization name and a CAPTCHA on the registration page, with the key emailed back.

reliability_note: Too many requests answer HTTP 429; the key expires unless renewed once a year.
confidence_note: Limits are read from the vendor FAQ and a keyless v1 call answered 200; the v2 key was not exercised.

evidence.proved: daily query limit 500 registered and 25 unregistered
request rate is 50 per 10 seconds on both versions
evidence.quote: | Request rate limit | 50 requests per 10 seconds | 50 requests per 10 seconds |

evidence.proved: registration asks for an email address and organization name plus a CAPTCHA
evidence.quote: enter your email address and organization name. Complete the CAPTCHA.

evidence.proved: the registration must be renewed yearly
evidence.quote: Users must renew registration with the BLS Public Data API at least once a year.

evidence.proved: flat-file survey directories are published for download
a keyless v1 call answered HTTP 200

notes: Keyless v1 at 25 queries a day; a free emailed key raises it to 500. Bulk path: flat files. Storage terms: unverified.
